resale_co.name: Transfer of Property Title (TOP), formerly called the Continuing (Continued) Certificate of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: Township of Bloomfield Fire Department, Fire Administration (Fire Prevention Bureau)
resale_co.lead_time: Application must be submitted 30 days before the closing date
requirements: General inspection of the visible parts of the building for code violations and unsafe conditions (fire, electrical, plumbing, building, property and grounds checklist)

Smoke and CO alarms on each floor and near all bedrooms; battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units unless hardwired, and battery alarms cannot replace hardwired ones (the TOP inspection also serves as the state smoke/CO certificate)
All construction permits, past and present, must be closed
Proof that any lead or galvanized water service line on the property has been replaced (plumber inspection documents the line material)
A Township-approved water meter must be installed, even if the house is winterized
Sump pumps and downspouts must not be connected to the sanitary sewer; sump pumps must drain outside
Rental property registration up to date; if the home will be a rental it must be registered within six months of closing
Heating equipment and water heaters properly vented; pressure relief valve discharge pipe; handrails on stairs with four or more risers; house properly numbered; sidewalks free of tripping hazards
Attached garage: fire-rated, self-closing door into the house
Portable fire extinguisher only for three-family and larger buildings

fees.label: Transfer of Property Title, single family residential dwelling
Transfer of Property Title, two family residential dwelling
Re-inspection after a failed inspection
fees.quote: *Re-inspection Fee due to Failure to pass requirements $25

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Transfer of Property Title Application (buyer and seller details, closing date, whether it will be a rental) and submit it to the Fire Department, Fire Administration, 375 Franklin Street, Bloomfield, NJ 07003, at least 30 days before closing. Payment by check, money order or credit card. Questions: 973-680-4153.

evidence.quote: APPLICATION MUST BE SUBMITTED 30 DAYS PRIOR TO THE CLOSING DATE.
THE TRANSFER OF PROPERTY TITLE IS VALID FOR A PERIOD OF SIX (6) MONTHS.
This inspection shall also serve as the CSACMAPFEC as required in 5:70-2.3 with regard to Smoke and Carbon Monoxide detectors.
All construction permits, past and present, are required to be closed before a TOP can be issued.
A Township approved water meter must be also installed.
Pursuant to Chapter 149, Section 3.D. of the Township code, the following fees will be charged for a Transfer of Property Title for the sale or transfer of property within the Township of Bloomfield:
Bloomfield Township Code requires that all people who sell their homes must get a Continuing Certificate of Occupancy from the Building Department.

resale_co.notes: The current application is called Transfer of Property Title (TOP) and is run by the Fire Department, Fire Administration (375 Franklin Street, 973-680-4153). Its file name still says CCO, and the Township FAQ still calls it a Continuing Certificate of Occupancy from the Building Department. The fees cite Chapter 149, Section 3.D of the Township code; the Construction fee ordinance (Ord. 25-12, 5/19/25) is posted only as a scanned PDF and was not read. Other fee rows on the form: three family $320, each additional unit $60 (not to exceed $2,000). Rental registration (Certificate of Habitability, $60 per rental unit) and the lead-safe inspection program are rental items, not resale requirements.

requirements: Smoke and CO alarms on each floor and in the vicinity of all bedrooms
Battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units unless hardwired; battery alarms cannot replace hardwired alarms
10-year sealed battery combination smoke/CO alarms are acceptable
Portable fire extinguisher required only for three-family and larger buildings (IFC 906.1), per the Township form

authorities.name: Bloomfield Fire Department, Fire Prevention Bureau (Fire Administration)
authorities.lead_time: The smoke/CO check is part of the Transfer of Property Title inspection; apply 30 days before closing. A separate smoke/CO certificate is available if a lender insists.

fees.label: Separate smoke and carbon monoxide detector certificate (only if the bank will not accept the Transfer of Property Title)
fees.quote: There is a $35.00 charge so see if they will accept the one certificate

authorities.how_to_apply: Normally no separate application: the Transfer of Property Title inspection serves as the CSACMAPFEC. If a lender insists on a separate certificate, ask the Fire Prevention Bureau at 973-680-4153.

evidence.quote: This certificate will suffice for the smoke and carbon monoxide detector compliance.
Should your bank insist on a separate certificate, the Fire Prevention Bureau will issue the separate certificate.
This inspection shall also serve as the CSACMAPFEC as required in 5:70-2.3 with regard to Smoke and Carbon Monoxide detectors.
It is also the local enforcing agency, which administers the New Jersey Fire Code within the Township

fire_cert.notes: Bloomfield combines the resale inspection and the smoke/CO certificate in one Fire Department inspection (Transfer of Property Title). The $35.00 separate certificate comes from an undated Township FAQ and may be out of date. The NJ DCA directory lists the smoke detector compliance phone as (973) 680-4153 and the Fire Official's own line as (973) 680-4053. The form does not ask for a fire extinguisher in one or two family homes, which matches P.L.2025, c.19.

other_items.label: Lead or galvanized water service line
other_items.detail: Before the Transfer of Property Title is issued, the owner must prove that any lead service line on the property has been replaced; a licensed plumber inspects and documents the service line. Questions: Engineering Department, 973-680-4009.

other_items.label: Water meter
other_items.detail: A Township-approved water meter must be installed, even if the house is winterized.

other_items.label: Sump pump and downspouts
other_items.detail: The inspection checks that sump pumps and downspouts are not connected to the sanitary sewer.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All construction permits, past and present, must be closed before the Transfer of Property Title is issued.
